climate.windNote: Bura (NE) is the dominant wind on ~45% of days: cold, dry, gusty; jugo (SE) on ~21% brings rain. ~3 days/month with max wind >= 40 km/h.
Windiest month: bura ~39% and jugo ~34% of days; ~3.6 days with max wind >= 40 km/h.
Changeable: jugo ~36%, bura ~31%, first maestral (NW) days ~22%. Sea still cold (coldest in February).
Calmer: jugo ~34%, bura ~25%, maestral ~22%; ~1.4 days with max wind >= 40 km/h. Mild cycling weather.
Maestral (NW afternoon sea breeze) grows to ~30% of days; jugo ~28%. Showers still common.
Maestral dominant (~47% of days): steady NW breeze in the afternoon, calm mornings. Strong wind rare (~0.4 days).
Peak maestral (~57% of days) cools hot afternoons; driest, sunniest month.
Maestral ~47% of days; short bura spells (~26%) after thunderstorms, especially late August.
Mixed: bura ~33%, maestral ~28%, jugo ~24%. Sea still warmer than in June; heavy but short storms.
Bura ~39%, jugo ~32%; maestral fades. ~1.6 days with max wind >= 40 km/h. Sea warmer than the air at night.
Wettest month: jugo (~29%) brings rain, bura (~50%) clears it; ~2.8 strong-wind days.
Bura dominant (~49% of days): cold, clear, gusty; jugo ~22%.

climateMethod.airMaxC_airMinC_rainDays_precipMm_wind: Open-Meteo historical archive (ERA5-based reanalysis), daily 2016-01-01..2025-12-31, request point 44.2587,15.1589; API snapped to grid cell 44.2531,15.2519 (~7 km east, inland, elevation 15 m), which likely makes summer highs ~1-2 °C warmer than at the beach. Mean of daily max/min per month; rainDays = mean count of days with precipitation >= 1 mm; precipMm = mean monthly total. Aggregated with jq.
climateMethod.wind: Share of days by daily dominant 10 m wind direction: bura = NE sector 10-90°, jugo = SE 100-170°, maestral = NW 270-340°. 'Strong-wind days' = daily max 10 m wind >= 40 km/h (sustained, not gusts). Modelled data, not a station record.
climateMethod.seaC: Open-Meteo marine API hourly sea_surface_temperature, grid cell 44.2917,15.1250 (sea between Nin and Vir), monthly mean over 2023-01..2025-12 (data available only from 2022-11-23). Only 3 years: medium confidence. seatemperature.info (Nin, 10-year averages) agrees within ~1 °C, Open-Meteo slightly warmer in spring/autumn.
climateMethod.sunHoursPerDay: DHMZ station normals for Zadar 1971-2000 (monthly sunshine hours / days in month), via Wikipedia 'Zadar' climate table. Open-Meteo's modelled sunshine_duration is also given in crossCheck but runs ~40-70% higher than station data (annual ~3,800 h vs DHMZ 2,567 h), so it is not used as the main figure.
climateMethod.precipitationWarning: Open-Meteo (ERA5 grid) precipitation runs ~1.5-2x the DHMZ Zadar station normals Oct-May (e.g. May 120 vs 65 mm, Nov 205 vs 106 mm), and its rainDays (>=1 mm) exceed the DHMZ precipitation days even though DHMZ counts days >=0.1 mm. For guest-facing pages prefer the DHMZ values in crossCheck (1971-2000 normals).

Apartment 3: the owner brief says 1 bedroom + balcony, 46 m2, but every public listing (Interhome Napros 3, kroati.de 41408) says 22 m2 for 2 guests with a 5 m2 balcony. Confirm size, beds and max guests. napros.si has no Apt 3 page (404).
Confirm that the cross-platform unit mapping is right (napros.si Apt1-4 = Interhome Napros 1-4 = Trip.com A1-A4 = kroati.de 41406/41407/41408/41405).
Apt1 'separate outdoor kitchen': no public listing mentions it (napros.si only says 'separate kitchen'). Is it outdoors, covered, shared or private to Apt1? What equipment?
Apt2 view: partial sea view (houfy) or courtyard view (kroati.de)?
Apt4 balcony: 5 m2 (houfy) or 3 m2 (kroati.de)?
Max guests per unit: Apt1 6 with sofa bed, Apt2 4, Apt3 2, Apt4 4 with sofa bed. Total villa capacity = 16? Can cots or extra beds be provided for direct bookings? Trip.com says no.
Air conditioning: Interhome says 'in part'. Is every bedroom and living room air-conditioned?
Number of parking spaces in total (Interhome implies 5: 2 for Apt1 + 1 each). Room for a van or bike trailer?
Pets: all listings say not allowed. Keep that for direct bookings or open to dog owners (a niche audience)?
Minimum stay (5 nights on Interhome/kroati.de) and check-in/out for direct bookings; is flexible check-in possible?
Direct-booking prices: kroati.de lists public per-night prices incl. taxes and cleaning (e.g. Apt1 EUR 130-153, Apt3 EUR 74-102). What direct rates and discounts should the new site show?
Booking.com review score and count: only 8.3/10 seen via a mirror; Trip.com shows 8.3 from 11 reviews. Owner should export the current Booking.com score, count and permitted guest quotes.
Languages actually spoken by the hosts: Booking lists CS, FR, HR, HU, SK. Are Slovenian, English, German available?
Booking.com lists the locality as 'Batalaži'. Should the new site use Sabunike, Privlaka or Nin as the main place name?
Is there a garden that is private to one unit, or one shared garden (houfy is contradictory)?
Wi-Fi speed (for remote-work and company retreat audiences) and whether there is a workspace or a covered area big enough for group meetings.
Secure storage for bicycles, and a bike wash or tools (for the cyclist audience)?
Washing machine: only Apt1 per listings. Is it available to other guests?
Photo rights: Booking/kroati.de photos may be the owner's uploads. Can they, and the napros.si originals, be reused, and are newer photos available (current ones date from 2021)?
Category is 2 stars on most listings (one Travelocity snippet said 3). Confirm the official categorisation.
Church of St Catherine (Trip.com, 780 m), Ninske Vodice beach and 'Grobni Humak' (Booking) are not found in OSM. Which local landmarks should the site name?
